definitions.explanation: The state of being superior or excellent.
The highest grade in the traditional Japanese grading system.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{優|ゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got an 'A' on the test.

examples.japanese: {優|ゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: They have the ability to compete for first place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優|ゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧、⟦{良|りょう}→良：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My grades were three A's and two B's.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}の{優|ゆう}を{競|きそ}う。
examples.english: To compete for superiority in quality.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{技術|ぎじゅつ}の{面|めん}で{優|ゆう}に{立|た}っている。
examples.english: He stands in a position of excellence in terms of skill.

examples.japanese: {全科目|ぜんかもく}で{優|ゆう}を{取|と}るのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It is difficult to get an A in every subject.

notes:
{優|ゆう} represents excellence or superiority. In the traditional Japanese academic grading system, it's the highest grade.

GRADING SYSTEM:
- {優|ゆう}: Excellent (A)
- {良|りょう}: Good (B)
- {可|か}: Pass (C)
- {不可|ふか}: Fail (F)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {優勝|ゆうしょう}: championship, victory
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}: excellent, outstanding
- {優先|ゆうせん}: priority
- {優位|ゆうい}: superiority, advantage

NOTE: As a standalone character, {優|やさ}しい means 'gentle/kind.'
